about_body:
A simple Minecraft: Java Edition launcher.

Create your own instances and fill them with mods, shaders and resource packs via the content manager and the Modrinth catalog.

Supports Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge loaders, offline profiles and Ely.by sign-in.

This launcher was built with the help of an AI assistant.
